Comment: audio-description: sibling run pointers -> understand (name map + watch notes) -> window plan (code) -> chunked writer + critic -> TTS synth/fit with a bounded reask loop -> the SEQUENTIAL repair chain -> coverage oracles + derived ledger + srt/vtt/DAPT/review.html + the render_manifest for media-processing's ad_mix group (the mix is a chained process_media call; this workflow renders no audio). The stage graph was validated by repeated zero-hand-edit runs scored against a corpus of professionally authored AD cues (README.md Design record #8). LOOP SHAPE: every multi-submission stage is ONE waitForTaskToken Task + ONE Choice — a sibling callback re-enters the same state (its payload carries no ad_loop_done), and the Lambda resolves its OWN token with {ad_loop_done: true} when the loop is finished, so no Choice ever depends on a sibling's payload shape. FAN-OUT extension: a loop with N independent tts shards resolves its own token with {tts_shard_tags} instead and the Choice routes through an inline Map — one waitForTaskToken Task per shard, each against ITS OWN token (a single token cannot wait for N callbacks: the first consumes it, the rest are TOKEN_GONE and the state sleeps to its deadman). Shard specs live in the checkpoint; the payload carries only tags. tts is Lambda-driven with no service throttle, so MaxConcurrency is unbounded. S3 checkpoints are the single source of truth; redrive IS the reconcile. Prompts are FIVE registry categories (frame-inspection's credits-read evidence arrives via the cast-resolution run's conditional credits output), iterable pre-GA. Readability copy of the template's inline DefinitionString; edit BOTH, the build fails on drift.
